title: Talk:The Mutanous Malaise

html:
Sitar Hero

In level one there is a quest to play Sitar Hero on Easy. You click on the guitar and go in to a mini instance. My question - how do you play this game? how do you get up the 'steps'? --Blue Octopus 01:11, 11 October 2007 (CEST)

to answer my own question - a big green dot appears on the chords - and when it reaches you - click on it quickly - ie 8 times so that you can get the notes. If you don't get it, then leave and re-enter. --Blue Octopus 04:28, 12 October 2007 (CEST)

Embercore path

There does lead an outpost on every dungeon at level 5, no matter what dungeon.. except the last one.. afcourse. Embercore path is actually already the dungeon but it contains a dungeon, in patch 93 there will come outposts for shadow embrace and embercore path, so i'll reverse it again ;) --LegendRunner 08:45, 13 October 2007 (CEST)

I know that there is no outpost to Embercore yet - I've been there - but despite clearing all of level 5 in MM there was no portal leading there. The only portla was the one from the boss romm off level 7. I recheecked level 5 very, very carefully to double check this. --Blue Octopus 18:19, 13 October 2007 (CEST)
